findings.title: ReadResult comment still says norn upgrade fixes needs_removed
findings.detail:
The doc comment on the needs_removed variant reads 'not corrupt, `norn upgrade` fixes it'. After this slice upgrade leaves `needs` alone; the person deletes it from the file. The comment now describes a fix that does not exist.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Reword to 'not corrupt; deleting `needs` from the file fixes it'.
